URL: https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/gulf/2026/07/20/iran-targets-bahrain-and-kuwait-after-ninth-night-of-us-strikes/
Retrieved 2026-07-20 via Exa search highlights. The National (UAE).

Iran targeted US allies Bahrain and Kuwait on Monday with drones, prompting air defence responses and emergency warnings across both Gulf states, as US carried out ninth consecutive night of strikes.
Iranian media reported strikes on Tabriz, where Iran operates missile and space facilities — site believed used to launch missiles that killed US personnel.
IRGC said it launched ballistic missile attacks against US military aircraft at Jordan's Aqaba airport, claiming "heavy damage" to American aircraft.
IRGC said two oil tankers near southern approaches to Strait of Hormuz exploded and were disabled, warning waterway remains unsafe while US "hostility" continues.

QUOTE - US Energy Secretary Chris Wright: Washington's main objective was ensuring oil and gas could continue to flow through the waterway.

Kuwait: power and desalination facility targeted for a second straight day; earlier Iranian army said it hit ammunition depot at Camp al-Adiri and Patriot radar / air radar at Ali Al Salem base. Jordan military said it shot down several Iranian missiles (no casualties/damage). Bahrain sounded missile alert sirens Monday morning.
